contracts.boundary: the real deterministic workload process, Hyperfine report parsing, and profile command construction
contracts.assertions: The workload reports the same checksum on repeat runs and selects the expected model; benchmark plans use the committed workload with an exported JSON report; profile plans write one artifact with a relative name; a missing Hyperfine binary exits 2 with an install hint; the workload is allowlisted and Knip does not treat the optional host tool as an npm dependency.

boundaryTest.name: the deterministic routing workload reports a stable checksum

invariant.name: builds Hyperfine plans for allowlisted workloads

fault.name: reports a missing Hyperfine binary as unavailable

contracts.boundary: the developer guide and agent guide read as repository files and checked against package.json and committed config paths
contracts.assertions: Every npm script named in the guide exists; every named tool configuration file exists; the agent guide links to the guide and the doctor command; the drift checker rejects an unknown script.

boundaryTest.name: every npm script named in the developer guide exists

invariant.name: the developer guide names the committed tool configuration files

fault.name: the command drift check reports an unknown npm script
